metadata.short_desc: Bind QQ numbers and nicknames, and manage user profiles.
metadata.desc: Fill sender IDs and nicknames for official QQ messages, retain original OpenIDs, and manage profiles in Dashboard.

profiles.title: User profiles
profiles.description: Manage nicknames, QQ numbers and command permissions.
profiles.intro: Manage nicknames and QQ numbers for each conversation.
profiles.notice: Fill the sender ID and nickname on each message
profiles.identity_notice: The original OpenID is retained for sessions and core permissions. QQ numbers are self-reported.
profiles.backend_hint: Off by default. When enabled, all plugin commands and aliases are disabled for every QQ user, including administrators. Profiles can only be managed here. Existing profiles still apply to conversations.
profiles.enabled: Enabled: plugin commands in QQ are disabled.
profiles.disabled: Disabled: users can manage their own profiles through QQ commands.
profiles.empty_admin: No profiles yet. Use “Add profile” above to register a user.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Users can send /nickname Alex and /bindqq 123456789, or you can add them here.
profiles.openid_hint: Original platform UID; available in the UMO
profiles.nickname_hint: Up to 32 characters; leave blank to clear
profiles.delete_hint: The original platform identity will be shown again. Existing conversations and permissions are retained.
profiles.open_dashboard: Open this page from the plugin details in AstrBot Dashboard.

errors.login: Please sign in to AstrBot Dashboard.
errors.json: The request must be a JSON object.
errors.bot: Select a configured official QQ bot.
errors.bool: The Dashboard-only setting must be a boolean.
errors.openid: Enter the original OpenID, not the complete UMO.
errors.fields: Only the nickname and QQ number can be changed.
errors.text: Nickname and QQ number must be text.
errors.nickname: Use up to 32 characters without control characters, line breaks, double quotes or bracket markup.
errors.qq: Use a 5–12 digit QQ number that does not start with 0.
errors.conflict: This profile has changed. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.deleted: This profile has changed or been deleted. Refresh and try again.

commands.platform: This command is only available for official QQ bots.
commands.blocked: Profile commands in QQ are disabled. Please contact an administrator to manage your profile in Dashboard.
commands.nickname_usage:
Usage: /nickname Alex
Up to 32 characters. Changes apply from the next message.
commands.nickname_saved: Nickname set to: {nickname}. It applies from the next message.
commands.qq_usage:
Usage: /bindqq YOUR_QQ_NUMBER
This registers profile information and does not grant administrator permissions.
commands.qq_saved: QQ number registered. It applies from the next message. The original OpenID and permissions are retained.
commands.clear_usage: To delete your nickname and QQ binding, send: /clearprofile confirm
commands.cleared: Profile cleared. The original OpenID, permissions and existing records are retained.
